modules.module_title: Prepare for installation of CNG Kit

pcs.pc_description: identify the work to be done and work requirements for the installation of CNG kit by interpreting the job card, CNG Kit manufacturer specifications related to the various brand/model/engine type/type of the vehicle (2/3/4 wheeler) etc.
identify and arrange required tools, equipment and CNG kit component required for the job
check tools, equipment and CNG kit component for any faults and required quality standards before use
follow standard operating procedure to validate and diagnose faults in CNG kit components
report the defects/malfunctions if any, in the tools, equipment & CNG kit components to the concerned person for rectification
co-ordinate with the concerned vendor/supplier for the required CNG kit and its components, wherever applicable
use appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) for safe working in workshop
use appropriate fitting methods and perform fitting operations to fit the CNG kit in vehicle (i.e. 2/3/4 wheeler) as per SOP/WI
follow government norms while installing CNG kit in BS6 petrol vehicles
make holes/cuts on various surfaces such as metal sheet, plastic, fabric etc., to fit the CNG kit components in the vehicle
remove dummy plugs, covers, old/damaged/defective parts etc. and clean the surrounding areas prior to installation of CNG kit components
make wiring connections as specified by the manufacturer to fit the electrical/electronic components of CNG Kit
assemble and secure all the components of the CNG Kit in vehicle in their correct positions by using appropriate assembly methods and techniques
fasten components permanently by using appropriate fasteners, screws etc. as per SOP
ensure correct calibration/tuning of engine after installation of CNG kit
ensure that all CNG kit components installed, fitted and functioning properly
perform road trial of vehicle to check CNG kit functioning and engine performance on both petrol and CNG modes
provide necessary information like features, functioning, precautions and maintenance requirements of CNG Kit to the customer
return leftover consumable/parts, tools/equipment etc. after completion of work
ensure that all the fitting and installation activities are completed before releasing the vehicle
dispose off packing wraps/box/covers and other material as per organization’s policies
prepare and maintain documents and records related to the CNG Kit fitment in vehicle as per organizational procedures
